nodes.name: Default Params
nodes.notes:
Edit template_ref to target a specific template.
user_id: the user to create synthetic data for.
The workflow downloads Generate_Data.xlsx from Supabase storage at PDF-templates/{template_ref}/Generate_Data.xlsx

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ p_user_id: $('Build Update Payload').first().json.user_id, p_details: $('Build Update Payload').first().json.details_jsonb }) }}

parameters.url: ={{ $('Build Update Payload').first().json.SUPABASE_URL }}/storage/v1/object/{{ $('Build Update Payload').first().json.SUPABASE_BUCKET }}/PDF-templates/{{ $('Build Update Payload').first().json.template_ref }}/Generate_Data.xlsx
